fallback: Missing/unsupported/corrupt tags =>original filename title/empty artist; no performer guessing
scope: Helper/imports only; parent owns index/service-worker inclusion and final atomic shell update.
evidence: Actual generated MP3/FLAC with synthetic tags via real CDP file chooser, HTMLMediaElement validity probe, IndexedDB and app reload. Correct lyric identity verified against deterministic synthetic LRCLIB response. Current playback survives concurrent import.
limitations: No M4A/WAV tag parser; playable files in these formats retain filename/empty-artist fallback.
Oversized artwork/tag blocks beyond the prefix limit are not scanned; supported tags within the bound are read.
No full-file metadata read, acoustic recognition, network catalog request or cover-art extraction.
Physical Safari/iOS not verified here; browser format support is still decided by the existing real media probe.
Existing imported records are not silently rescanned; metadata is read for new explicit imports.
